component-o.description-s: 10 A 32 VDC ATOF automotive blade fuse (ATO/ATC size, red), 1000 A @ 32 VDC interrupting, 7.70 mOhm typical cold resistance; seated in a PCB blade holder (Keystone 3557-2)
component-o.pin_roles_note-s: pin roles: a fuse (and its holder) is non-polar; pin 1 = supply side (ds-power-rx) and pin 2 = load side (ds-power-tx) is a convention only, as on the DSK310 series diode; either orientation is electrically the same
component-o.supply_pins_are_pass_note-s: a fuse in the power path: its pins are the two blade terminals, which have no operating supply range of their own; the fuse ratings in fuse-o (10 A, 32 VDC, 7.70 milliohm typical cold) are the figures the checks use

cold_resistance_source-o.table-s: Ratings, row 0287010._: 10 A, test cable 1 mm2, typical voltage drop 109 mV, typical cold resistance 7.70 mOhm, typical I2t 115 A2s (typical values; no measuring condition printed beyond the test cable size)

holder_source-o.table-s: 2 IN 1 FUSE HOLDER: for Littelfuse ATOF 287 series / Bussmann ATC series, Littelfuse Low Profile Mini (LP) series or equivalents

source-o.table-s: Specifications: voltage rating 32 V DC; interrupting rating 1000 A @ 32 V DC; recommended environmental temperature -40 to +125 C (ATOF); terminals tin- or silver-plated; housing PA66, UL94 V-2; SAE J1284 / ISO 8820-3

not_stated-o.speed_class: the sheet gives time-current curves (p3), not a fast / slow class name; automotive ATO blades are fast-acting by their curves, recorded as fast-blow

provenance-o.basis-s: procurement public-check: every document in the record folder has a public http(s) source; nothing confidential, no correspondence or quote data, no person named outside non-technical-o, not an NDA part; footprint and 3D model of recorded public origin
